name: Argonz AI Text Assistant
author: Arman Daneshdoost

sections.description:
You can watch how to work with this plugin through this tutorial video link:
ArgonzAI

Plugin Features and Benefits
1. Post Summarization:
The plugin automatically summarizes post content using proprietary models from each service. This process generates concise and optimized summaries, helping users quickly grasp the main points of the text without wasting time. This feature is particularly useful for websites with long and complex content.

  1. SEO-Based Content Editing and Rewriting:
    The plugin rewrites post content according to SEO principles using various models from the provided services. The rewritten content is presented as suggestions to the site owner, who can choose to accept or ignore them.

  2. Suggested Keywords:
    The plugin evaluates post content using selected models and provides the site owner with the most relevant SEO keywords based on Persian content trends. These keywords are carefully selected through precise and up-to-date analysis, helping improve the site’s search engine ranking.

  3. Improved Site Ranking:
    By using the suggested keywords and optimized content, users can enhance their site’s ranking on search engines, leading to increased traffic and more audience engagement.

  4. Time-Saving:
    The plugin automates summarization, editing, and keyword suggestion processes, helping users manage their time more efficiently. This is especially beneficial for professional content creators dealing with large volumes of content.

  5. Flexibility and Full Control:
    Site owners have the option to use or ignore the plugin’s suggestions, giving them complete control over their content.

  6. Advanced Technology:
    The plugin uses APIs from advanced services and processes text with high precision based on complex algorithms, ensuring accurate and high-quality results.

Conclusion
This plugin is a comprehensive and practical tool that helps site owners improve content quality, reduce content production time, and enhance their site’s search engine ranking. By using this plugin, users can professionally edit and summarize content, identify relevant keywords, and improve their site’s competitive position online. If you’re looking for a technical and effective solution to manage and optimize your content, this plugin is an ideal choice for you.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/my-plugin directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

This plugin is an advanced tool for summarizing posts, editing content, and suggesting relevant keywords using two AI-powered NLP services. Users need an API key for access.

How is the post content edited?

Depending on the service and model you choose, an SEO-reviewed text will be provided as a suggestion in the metabox of each post.

What are the suggested keywords?

The suggested keywords are generated by your chosen model. The model identifies them based on SEO for Persian content and provides them to you.
